# FreeConvert.com

> Free online file conversion platform supporting audio, video, image, and document format transformations with 2M+ daily conversions.

FreeConvert.com provides a comprehensive suite of online file conversion tools supporting hundreds of format combinations across media types including MP3, MP4, MOV, PNG, WEBP, SVG, HEIC, JPG, PDF, EPUB, and DOCX. The platform offers fast, browser-based conversion without software installation, serving millions of users globally with multi-language support.
